pages.text: There she is. Everything you need to know is in that book, and what isn't, I'll tell you myself.

&6Profile&r shows your stats and level. &6Skills&r has a card for every trade. &6Settings&r changes nearly everything, including where the little boxes on your screen sit. You can drag them about in the HUD editor.
Quests in Skyhaven have a rhythm: someone offers, you accept, you do the thing, and then you come back to hand it in. That's when you get paid. A little ceremony never hurt anyone.
